skill.name: redesign-existing-projects
skill.description: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.
skill.summary: Guides focused redesigns of existing web apps while preserving the current stack.
skill.author: leonxlnx

content.value_statement: Existing apps often feel generic, inconsistent, or unfinished. This skill audits the interface and applies focused visual upgrades without changing the core stack.
actual_capabilities: Audits typography, color, layout, motion, content, and component patterns.
Identifies common generic AI design choices in existing web interfaces.
Suggests targeted visual upgrades for Tailwind, vanilla CSS, and other styling systems.
Prioritizes changes by visual impact and implementation risk.
Calls out missing states, accessibility basics, metadata, and review checks.
limitations: It provides design guidance and does not include executable automation scripts.
It relies on the assistant to inspect and modify the target project correctly.
It does not replace product strategy, user research, or brand design work.
Some visual suggestions need manual judgment and browser testing.

use_cases.title: Polish a SaaS dashboard
use_cases.description: Improve hierarchy, states, spacing, and empty screens without changing the application workflow.

use_cases.title: Refresh a marketing site
use_cases.description: Replace generic hero sections, cards, gradients, and stock content with more specific visual choices.

use_cases.title: Review an AI-generated prototype
use_cases.description: Find repeated AI design fingerprints and turn the prototype into a more credible interface.

prompt_templates.title: Run a basic design audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the redesign-existing-projects skill to audit this app. List the highest-impact typography, color, layout, and state issues before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Improve one page safely
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused redesign of a single screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the redesign-existing-projects skill on this page only. Keep the current framework and improve spacing, hierarchy, component styling, and interaction states.

prompt_templates.title: Remove generic AI design patterns
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate polish pass for an AI-generated site.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the redesign-existing-projects skill to identify generic AI design patterns in this project. Replace them with specific visual choices that fit the product.

prompt_templates.title: Deliver a staged redesign plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced redesign across a larger project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the redesign-existing-projects skill to inspect the whole interface. Create a prioritized redesign plan, then implement reviewable changes in small stages.

output_examples.input: Audit a plain landing page with generic cards and a purple gradient hero.
output: A ranked list of design issues across typography, palette, layout, content, and component patterns.
Specific recommendations for a stronger hero, fewer card patterns, better spacing, and more credible content.
A suggested change order that starts with low-risk typography and color improvements.

output_examples.input: Redesign a dashboard while preserving its React and Tailwind setup.
output: A focused implementation plan that keeps the existing stack and component structure.
Improved empty, loading, error, hover, active, and focus states.
A final testing checklist covering responsiveness, imports, and core workflows.

output_examples.input: Review whether an AI-built prototype feels production ready.
output: A plain-language critique of generic copy, placeholder assets, weak hierarchy, and missing metadata.
Concrete design upgrades that make the prototype feel more specific and complete.

best_practices: Start with an audit before editing so changes are targeted and reviewable.
Preserve the existing framework, styling system, routes, and core behavior.
Test responsive layouts, keyboard focus, and key interactions after each change.
anti_patterns: Do not rewrite the app from scratch when focused visual upgrades are enough.
Do not add new libraries before checking the project dependency file.
Do not treat decorative polish as a substitute for accessibility and working states.

faq.question: Does this skill generate a full redesign from scratch?
faq.answer: No. It is built for improving an existing project while keeping its current stack and functionality.

faq.question: Which styling systems does it support?
faq.answer: It can guide changes in Tailwind, vanilla CSS, styled components, and similar project-specific styling systems.

faq.question: Can it help with accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It calls out focus rings, semantic HTML, alt text, skip links, and form validation basics.

faq.question: Will it install design libraries automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs the assistant to check existing dependencies before importing any new library.

faq.question: Is it only for marketing pages?
faq.answer: No. It includes guidance for landing pages, dashboards, forms, navigation, empty states, and component systems.

faq.question: How should I use it on a large app?
faq.answer: Ask for an audit first, approve a prioritized plan, then apply changes page by page.
